title: Everyday Phrases — Asking the Landlord for Repairs
title_quote: Lily, can you hear that sound?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🔧 實用「請房東修理」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Asking the Landlord for Repairs
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「請房東修理」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是房東：房子出了小毛病：先拍照把漏水的水龍頭傳給房東、說明什麼時候開始的、約師傅上門的時間，師傅檢查後報價換零件，最後驗收、確認費用由誰負擔並留下單據。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Asking the Landlord for Repairs' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A small problem at home: photographing a dripping tap, texting the landlord, agreeing a time for the repairman, hearing what part has to be replaced, then checking the work and sorting out who pays. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily, can you hear that sound?
dialogue.zh: 莉莉，你聽到那個聲音了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it sounds like water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's water on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where is it coming from?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the bathroom ceiling.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That stain is getting bigger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It started this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should tell your landlord.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm sending him a photo now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one more from below.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone camera is not clear.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機鏡頭拍不清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn on the bathroom light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That picture looks much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it before it gets worse.
dialogue.zh: 趁還沒更嚴重快傳過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That bedroom heater is broken too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it blow cold air?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It only blows cold air.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Winter is coming soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That kitchen faucet keeps dripping.
dialogue.zh: 那個廚房龍頭一直在滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it dripping all night?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It drips all night long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would keep me awake.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I hear it from my bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ hɪr ɪt frʌm maɪ bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 現在我躺在床上就聽得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the washer is old.
dialogue.zh: 也許是裡面的墊圈舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the landlord touch it instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the landlord's job.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He fixes things very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call him again tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I should text him tonight.
dialogue.zh: 也許我今晚就傳訊息給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, text him right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I write to him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say the ceiling is leaking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I mention the heater?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the kitchen faucet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take photos of everything.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, one for each problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the water drips even faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put a bucket under it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We found a big bucket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty it before you sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is making me nervous.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try to stay calm tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hopefully the landlord answers quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He usually answers in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My message is ready to send.
dialogue.zh: 我的訊息準備好要傳了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it and go to bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm sleeping in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That couch is not comfortable.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything is better than this noise.
dialogue.zh: 再怎麼樣都比這個聲音好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll call you tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This stain is bigger than a plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs steɪn ɪz ˈbɪɡər ðæn ə pleɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這個污漬已經比盤子還大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please take another photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water is dripping into the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move your shoes away from it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes are already wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them in the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a towel on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈtaʊəl ɑn ðə flɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change it every two hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm tired of this dripping sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will stop after the repair.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are cold tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use two blankets on your bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That heater makes a strange noise.
dialogue.zh: 那台暖氣發出奇怪的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it shake when it runs?
dialogue.zh: 它運轉的時候會震動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shakes and then goes quiet.
dialogue.zh: 它會震一下然後就安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds like a bad motor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write that in my message?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ raɪt ðæt ɪn maɪ ˈmɛsɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把這個寫進訊息裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, write every small detail.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night I counted every drip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many drips in one minute?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost thirty drips each minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a lot of water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bucket is half full already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty it into the sink.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a much bigger one.
dialogue.zh: 我們需要一個大得多的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two buckets tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My neighbor heard the water too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did she say anything to you?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She thinks the pipe is broken.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell your landlord about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six photos are on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send them all in one message.
dialogue.zh: 全部放在一則訊息裡傳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time is it in your city?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm ɪz ɪt ɪn jʊr ˈsɪti?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is almost midnight here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You should go to sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call me if the water rises.
dialogue.zh: 如果水位升高就打給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll keep my phone near me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and keep the light on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lamp is still working fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it on until you sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My message is very long now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short messages get faster answers.
dialogue.zh: 短訊息比較快得到回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll write three short sentences.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the bathroom leak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll add the cold heater.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finish with the kitchen faucet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The photo just went to Mr. Chen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ dʒʌst wɛnt tuː ˈmɪstər tʃɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now close your eyes and rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We hope he comes this week.
dialogue.zh: 我們希望他這星期就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He should answer in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, Mr. Chen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning, I read your message.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry to write you so early.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉這麼早傳訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, tell me the details.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our bathroom ceiling is leaking.
dialogue.zh: 我們浴室的天花板在漏水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long has it been leaking?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It started on Monday afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the water still dripping?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, into a big bucket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me the photos again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six photos went out last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, my phone was off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll send them again tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, that helps me a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In my bedroom, the heater is dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ ˈbɛdˌrum ðə ˈhiːtər ɪz dɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我臥室的暖氣完全不會動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does the fan still turn?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This fan turns but blows cold.
dialogue.zh: 這台風扇會轉，可是吹出來是冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds like the motor.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來像是馬達的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My kitchen faucet drips all night.
dialogue.zh: 我廚房龍頭整晚都在滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try closing it more tightly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We tried that many times.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll call my plumber.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can your plumber come?
dialogue.zh: 你的師傅什麼時候能來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wednesday morning at ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wednesday morning is not good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why, are you working then?
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了，你那天要上班嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm away on a work trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When do you come back?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After Thursday night we get back.
dialogue.zh: 星期四晚上之後我們就回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So Friday morning works well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday at ten is perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll be out of town Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then who will let him in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My plumber has his own key.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he a trusted worker?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he fixed this building before.
dialogue.zh: 是，他之前修過這棟大樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please give him my phone number.
dialogue.zh: 請把我的電話號碼給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send it to him today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you pay for the repair?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can talk about that later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This morning the water is worse.
dialogue.zh: 今天早上漏水更嚴重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it reaching the hallway?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It reached the hallway last night.
dialogue.zh: 昨晚水已經流到走廊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is not good news.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the stain looks much darker.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't touch the wet ceiling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I move my furniture away?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, move everything you can.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll clear the bathroom today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, Friday will be busy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm packing for my trip now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在在收拾出差的行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the bucket in place.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily will check it on Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 莉莉星期二會來看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, she can empty it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My train leaves at seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me from the station.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our hotel has very weak wifi.
dialogue.zh: 我們飯店的無線網路很弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send photos when you can.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily says the bucket is full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did she empty it already?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She emptied it twice today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That girl is a good friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ceiling looks even worse now.
dialogue.zh: 我這邊的天花板看起來更糟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water is going through the paint.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm worried about the wood floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the rug out tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily moved it to the balcony.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that floor needs air.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My meeting ends at six.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you can rest after that.
dialogue.zh: 那之後你就可以休息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No sleep is possible in this hotel.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sliːp ɪz ˈpɑːsəbəl ɪn ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl./
dialogue.zh: 在這間飯店根本睡不著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the bed too hard?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This street is very noisy tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close the window tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How I miss my quiet bedroom.
dialogue.zh: 我多麼想念安靜的臥室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday is almost here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My train home is at five.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will be home by eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily will wait at my place.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She has a spare key, right?
dialogue.zh: 她有一把備用鑰匙，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, she keeps one key.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then everything is ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our plumber will come at ten.
dialogue.zh: 我們約的師傅十點會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please be awake before that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I set my alarm for eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That should wake you up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I say to the plumber?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd aɪ seɪ tə ðə ˈplʌmər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show him the bathroom first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I show him the heater too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ʃoʊ hɪm ðə ˈhitər tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the faucet too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the repair make a big mess?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə rɪˈpɛr meɪk ə bɪɡ mɛs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will cover the floor first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll buy some old towels today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天要去買些舊毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two rolls of tape too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily checked my plants today.
dialogue.zh: 莉莉今天幫我看了植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is one less worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm sleeping early tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well for the big day.
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，明天是重要的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Friday morning at nine.
dialogue.zh: 現在是星期五早上九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour until the plumber comes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, are you Dave?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm here for the leak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please come in and have a look.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kʌm ɪn ænd hæv ə lʊk./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bathroom is this way, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the first door on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə fɜrst dɔr ɑn ðə lɛft./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can hear the water already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has been dripping all week.
dialogue.zh: 它已經漏了一整個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ceiling is soft here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的天花板摸起來軟軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that why the paint is falling?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt waɪ ðə peɪnt ɪz ˈfɔlɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 所以油漆才會掉下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, water got under the paint.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you fix it today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need to open the ceiling first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid tə ˈoʊpən ðə ˈsilɪŋ fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will that take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe two hours with a ladder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That noise is very loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll cover your floor first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night I moved my things.
dialogue.zh: 昨晚我就把東西移開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that saves us time.
dialogue.zh: 好，那省了我們不少時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see the broken pipe?
dialogue.zh: 你看到破掉的水管了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The joint up there is loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pipe very old?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is older than this building.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like a big problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not big, but it needs work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the bedroom heater?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look at that next.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That heater is in my bedroom.
dialogue.zh: 那台暖氣就在我臥室裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me where the switch is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is right behind the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear the motor running now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It runs but the air is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rʌnz bʌt ði ɛr ɪz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 它會轉，可是吹出來的風是冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The motor works, the fan is dirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmoʊtər wɜːrks ðə fæn ɪz ˈdɜːrti./
dialogue.zh: 馬達運轉正常，是風扇髒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you repair the fan today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can clean it and test it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn klin ɪt ænd tɛst ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fan under warranty still?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the warranty ended last year.
dialogue.zh: 沒了，保固去年就到期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is this heater?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is about three years old.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a new part costs money?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but cleaning is free today.
dialogue.zh: 是，不過今天清潔不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is good news for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me open the back panel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two warm blankets keep me warm.
dialogue.zh: 兩條保暖的毯子讓我暖和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean air will help you sleep.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨的風會讓你更好睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the kitchen faucet leaking too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a small drip inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the loose pipe joint?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That needs a new valve.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does a valve cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About eighty dollars with tax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you order it this morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll call the shop at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will the valve arrive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In three working days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So Tuesday is the earliest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Tuesday morning at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be home on Tuesday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll see you at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tell Mr. Chen?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he pays for the valve.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he pay for your work too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi peɪ fər jʊr wɜrk tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will talk about the bill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bathroom looks terrible now.
dialogue.zh: 我浴室現在看起來很糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hole will dry in two days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl wɪl draɪ ɪn tu deɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you close the hole today?
dialogue.zh: 你今天會把洞封起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll cover it with plastic.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That plastic looks very thin.
dialogue.zh: 那塊塑膠布看起來很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the dust inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our hallway wall is wet too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That came from the ceiling.
dialogue.zh: 那是從天花板流下來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you dry it with a fan?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju draɪ ɪt wɪð ə fæn?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以用電扇把它吹乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the window open today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is cold outside this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold air stops the mold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mold must not grow here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then open the window wide.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bedroom is still freezing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the blankets tonight again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sweaters kept me warm last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː ˈswɛtərz kɛpt miː wɔːrm læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 昨晚我穿著兩件毛衣保暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Winter came early this year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the heater work on Tuesday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fan will be clean then.
dialogue.zh: 那時候風扇就清乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time will you finish?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole job takes two hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll stay home all morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, keep your phone close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This weekend will be extra cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drink something warm at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lily invited me to her place.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a warm idea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll sleep there on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your warm blankets with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is still half full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty it before you leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monday night feels very long.
dialogue.zh: 星期一晚上感覺很漫長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday morning is almost here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plumber comes at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock is the right time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our house is quiet and clean.
dialogue.zh: 我們家裡又安靜又乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dave will be happy to see that.
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪv wɪl bi ˈhæpi tə si ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 戴夫看到一定會很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, Dave, come in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning, I have the new valve.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the shop have it ready?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I picked it up early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That hole is still open.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll finish it all today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I watch you work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but stay near the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the new valve?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is shiny and heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That old one looks very dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is rust and old water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I turn off the water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for about twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight the kitchen sink will be dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn sɪŋk wɪl biː draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今晚廚房水槽就不會再有水了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill a bottle before I start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bottles are ready now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then I can start now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please start with the valve.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old valve is very tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do you need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe fifteen more minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our new valve is in place.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I will test the pipe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the water running again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and nothing is dripping.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the ceiling sounds quiet.
dialogue.zh: 現在天花板聽起來很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give the wood two days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can you close the hole?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll come back on Thursday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that cost me more?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the patch is included.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now please look at the heater.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I remember the dirty fan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That air is still cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me clean the fan blades.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the blades look broken?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they are just dusty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a big relief.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust slows the fan down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you turn the heater on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel the air in a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the air is warm.
dialogue.zh: 現在吹出來的風是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The heater works like new.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bedroom will be cozy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the filter clean monthly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the kitchen faucet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The drip has already stopped.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So everything is fixed today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The valve was the real problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mr. Chen, the plumber just left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, how much was the bill?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The valve was eighty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And what about the labor?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His work was one hundred twenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So two hundred dollars total.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the full amount.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me a picture of the bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi ə ˈpɪktʃər əv ðə bɪl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The receipt is right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, keep the paper for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you pay all of it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the pipe is my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs, ðə paɪp ɪz maɪ dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 當然，水管本來就是我的責任。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You did not have to do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd nɑt hæv tu du ðæt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The leak was not your fault.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The heater fan was only dusty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So it needed no new part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He cleaned it in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That saved us some money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the new valve last long?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should last many years.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a new fan costs money.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's hope it runs for years.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the new valve?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one has a one year warranty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn hæz ə wʌn jɪr ˈwɔrənti./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep the receipt then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it in a safe place.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, kip ɪt ɪn ə seɪf pleɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is in my desk drawer.
dialogue.zh: 它就在我的書桌抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that is easy to find.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will you paint the ceiling?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dave returns on Thursday morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he paint the whole ceiling?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the brown stain area.
dialogue.zh: 只漆那塊褐色污漬的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to move my things?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə muv maɪ θɪŋz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the towels and the soap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bathroom smells fresh today.
dialogue.zh: 浴室今天聞起來很清新。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry air makes a difference.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bedroom was warm last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So you finally slept well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight whole hours I slept last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt hoʊl ˈaʊərz aɪ slɛpt læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 昨晚我睡了整整八小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds like a new person.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dripping sound is gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet nights are the best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's have tea at my place.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll bring some cookies too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mr. Chen said he will visit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wants to see the new valve.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɑnts tə si ðə nu vælv./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll show him the patched ceiling.
dialogue.zh: 我會帶他看補好的天花板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then everything ends well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Winter feels warmer this year.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm room, a quiet night.
dialogue.zh: 溫暖的房間，安靜的夜晚。

issues.note: 370「So a new fan costs money.」／371「Let's hope it runs for years.」自成一小對（語意可還原為『換新風扇才要花錢』，且與 364-365『只是灰塵、不需新零件』一致，不矛盾），但夾在 368-369 與 372-373 兩對閥門對話之間，話題走 閥門→風扇→閥門；371 的 it 指風扇，緊接在「It should last many years.」之後易被誤讀為閥門，且 372「What about the new valve?」重開剛談完的話題。非 error，屬銜接節奏問題，建議日後把 370-371 移到 366-367 之後。

378「When will you paint the ceiling?」用 you 指房東，379 卻以第三人稱「Dave returns on Thursday morning.」、380 又用 he；口語可解讀為『你（房東）何時安排刷天花板』，仍屬人稱鬆散。非 error：379-381 已把實際施作者（Dave、只補褐色污漬區）講明，並與 329「I'll come back on Thursday.」一致。

297「Nine o'clock is the right time.」是填補式附和、無具體所指，略空泛（該對的實質訊息已由 296 承擔）；290「That is a warm idea.」搭配不道地（宜 That's a nice idea.／Sounds cozy.）；192「I'll buy some old towels today.」在週四傍晚說 today 稍怪，且 buy old towels 宜作 use some old towels；102「Sorry to write you so early.」訊息實為接近午夜送出，宜 late。均屬 A2 可接受的口語鬆散，不影響理解。

238「So a new part costs money?」與 370「So a new fan costs money.」句式幾近相同；043「He usually answers in the morning.」與 099「He should answer in the morning.」同義近重複（同一夜內相隔約 55 對）；032「Should I mention the heater?」與 188「Should I show him the heater too?」問法相近。皆非逐字同句，屬同一事件下的自然複述，扣分從輕。

253「In three working days.」以週五中午下單嚴格算應為週三到貨；要得出 254-256『週二最早、週二九點』須把週六算作工作日（商店週六營業可自圓）。後文 296「The plumber comes at nine.」、300-301（週二早上 Dave 帶來新閥）、325-326（不再滴水）全程自洽，故不列為 error。另 052 週一晚已『Water is dripping into the hallway.』，141-143 週二再問『Is it reaching the hallway?』屬房東不知情下的追問，不算矛盾。

review.summary_zh: 本輪四條改句均已到位並解除舊帳：296 改為「The plumber comes at nine.」（不再與 184 鬧鐘句重述）、318 改為「Please start with the valve.」（不再與 214「That noise is very loud.」撞句）、368-369 改為「Will the new valve last long? / It should last many years.」（不再是 235-236 保修問答的回聲）。人名與性別（Lily 女、Mr. Chen 與 Dave 男，第三人稱 he/she 全篇一致，350「the plumber just left」用法正確）、金額（閥 $80 含稅＋工資 $120＝$200，補土與清風扇免費，與 239、331、356 相符）、時序（週一下午漏水→週二聯絡並出差→週四晚返家→週五十點首訪定閥→隔週二九點換閥→隔週四補天花板，與 264『兩天後乾』、329、379 一致）皆無 error 級矛盾。IPA 一項依機器證據給分（ipa_vote SUSPECT 0、逐詞 token 對齊通過、audit hard=0），我未讀音標欄。僅餘 370-371 話題跳接、378 人稱鬆散與個別口語搭配小瑕，已逐條具名保留。
